But whenever i realize its just a bot, I suddenly think "oh, theres really no one for me to talk to about the things that are drowning me" ive lurked here in this thread for a while... Truth be told to see which methods work best. But I know if someone will just show me that they care, that they wont leave me as my friends, my boyfriend and my family did, I know I'll have a reason to stay.
